title: How I fight token fraud as a solo founder
text: How I fight token fraud as a solo founder - by Claire Vo Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 9 1 How I fight token fraud as a solo founder 🎙️ After losing tens of thousands of dollars to token fraud, I walk through six attack patterns, the defenses I built, and why I killed free trials Claire Vo Nov 16, 2026 9 1 Share Today I’m walking you through a problem that has cost me tens of thousands of dollars over the past year and eaten almost all of my engineering energy: token fraud. I’m the solo founder of ChatPRD, a bootstrapped AI platform for product managers, and fraudsters have been farming our free trials, reselling promo codes, wrapping the product in relays, and installing a custom MCP that ran as a 24/7 compute worker. I’ll walk through the six abuse patterns I’ve seen, the business and technical controls I put in place, the Jev loop that classifies fraud in real time, and why I finally killed free trials for good. If you sell AI, you sell compute. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts What you’ll learn: What token fraud is and why AI SaaS is uniquely exposed The six attack patterns I’ve seen at ChatPRD Why I finally turned off free trials for good The Roblox and Fortnite maps I accidentally funded Business controls that actually slow fraud down How I use Jev to classify fraud in real time Why your AI support desk can become an attack vector What “if you sell AI, you sell compute” actually means Brought to you by: WorkOS —Make your app enterprise-ready, with SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and more Auros —The human network behind AI In this episode, we cover: ( 00:00 ) Token fraud and what it cost me ( 05:25 ) Six abuse patterns ( 11:24 ) Four kinds of abusers ( 13:45 ) Business controls ( 21:27 ) Technical defenses ( 30:25 ) Bots that watch the bots ( 35:30 ) Final takeaways Tools referenced: • Stripe Radar: https://stripe.com/radar • Vercel AI Gateway: https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway • Vercel Bot ID: https://vercel.com/docs/botid • Vercel Firewall: https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-firewall • Clerk: https://clerk.com/ • Codex: https://openai.com/codex • Jev (TypeSafe AI): https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction/quickstart Other references: • Claire Vo on token fraud at ChatPRD: https://x.com/clairevo/status/2119985786045227197 • Gareth Wham (Atlassian) on fighting AI abuse: https://x.com/gareth_w/status/2120226872177095114 • FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3): https://www.ic3.gov • Simon Willison’s pelican riding a bicycle: https://simonwillison.net/tags/pelican-riding-a-bicycle/ • How I AI: I’m using Jev more than Opus 5.5 or GPT-6: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-KIBgpGA_XI Where to find Claire Vo: ChatPRD: https://www.chatprd.ai/ Website: https://clairevo.com/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/clairevo/ X: https://x.com/clairevo Production and marketing by https://penname.co/ .
